description:
Use before relying on a company's financials or projections, to catch errors and
    unrealistic assumptions. Institutional validation pass over company financials: tax-rate sanity,
    EBITDA/EBIT bridge, growth continuity vs historical CAGR, capex ratio,
    working-capital stability. Returns integrity score + severity-ranked flags.
    $0.50/call after free trial.

financials.description: Company financials as a JSON object. Uses 'historical_financials' and 'projections', each holding yearly lists such as income_statement (revenue, ebitda, ebit, income_before_tax, income_taxes), balance_sheet (net_working_capital) and capex. Missing years or fields are skipped, not guessed.
